notes: No usable 4-year/2-year plan exists: the Feller Center's 'BA PSYC - Two Year Plan' PDF (linked from the checklist) failed to convert. Multicultural course filled with PSYC354 (Multicultural Psychology), one of the department page's own named multicultural options; PSYC354 is also Theme III (Social, Developmental & Organizational Studies) per the department's PSYC Courses & PSYC Syllabi page.

PSYC 400-Level Non-Lab slots filled with PSYC401 and PSYC403; the 400-Level Lab slot filled with PSYC424 -- real, currently-approved PSYC courses (from the builder brief's approved-course list), chosen only to fill the count/credit requirement since neither source names specific 400-level courses. PSYC330 and PSYC353 were chosen for Theme II coverage only (both have just a PSYC100 prerequisite); not verified for topical fit beyond the department's own theme listing.

The plan previously filled remaining credits with PSYC302 and PSYC303 to reach the major's 35-credit/11-course total; PSYC302 was dropped as redundant (Theme I was already covered) and PSYC303 was dropped because the department's PSYC Courses & PSYC Syllabi page lists it under courses that 'do not apply towards degree requirements'.
